name: Authenticate with Passkey
summary: Authenticates an existing durable identity using a single-use passkey challenge and establishes the permitted authenticated session.

completionPredicate.expression: credential-proof == passkey-proved and durable-identity == resolved and session-capability in [authenticated-limited,authenticated-normal]

coverageAssessment.rationale: Successful authentication and two important security rejection paths are represented, but challenge issuance and additional authenticator failure outcomes are not independently modeled.
